description: Trigger a form elicitation with a caller-supplied JSON schema; returns the raw {action, content}. For a plain OK/Cancel question, prefer elicit_confirm. MUST NOT be used to request secrets, credentials, or other sensitive information.

message.description: The instruction shown to the user above the form fields.

requestedSchema.description: JSON Schema for the form, restricted to the MCP elicitation requestedSchema subset: a flat object whose properties are strings, numbers/integers, booleans, or enums — no nested objects, arrays of objects, $ref, or allOf. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/client/elicitation#requested-schema

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the answer, in seconds (default 300, clamped 60-3600) — raise it for forms with several fields.

name: elicit_form

action.description: accept = the user submitted the form; decline = an explicit no; cancel = dismissed unanswered (including timeout); error = the elicitation failed.

content.description: On accept, the submitted values keyed by requestedSchema property name; null for every other action.

title: Ask the user to fill a form
